articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, Dōngdān Diànyǐngyuàn shi bu shi zài zhèr fùjìn?
MR. ANDERSON: May I ask, is the Dōngdān Movie Theater in this area?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Shì. Zài zhèr fùjìn.
COMRADE WÁNG: Yes. It's in this area.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Cóng zhèr dào nàr qù, zěnme zǒu?
MR. ANDERSON: How do I get there from here?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Chūle zhèige fàndiàn wàng dōng zǒu. Dàole dìèrge lùkǒur, běibianr shi Dōngdān Càishìchǎng.
COMRADE WÁNG: Go out of the hotel and walk east. At the second intersection, the Dōngdān Market is on the north side.
MR. ANDERSON: How about on the south side?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Nánbianr shi Dōngdān Gōngyuán. Diànyǐngyuàn jiù zài càishìchǎngde xībianr.
COMRADE WÁNG: On the south side is Dōngdān Park. The theater is just on the west side of the market.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Nǐ zhīdao diànyǐngyuàn fùjìn yǒu meiyou yínháng?
MR. ANDERSON: Do you know whether there is a bank near the theater?
WÁNG TÓNGZHÌ: Yǒu. Diànyǐngyuàn fùjìn yǒu yíge yínháng.
COMRADE WÁNG: Yes. There is a bank near the movie theater.
